title: Testing phase result (dev team, test-report.md)
description: Validates the structured result object the testing phase returns alongside its test-report.md artifact. artifactPath must equal the artifact name the phase declares in team.yml (the core's runtime enforces the same exact match); openQuestions stay optional because a run whose plan executed fully and found nothing open legitimately has none — but coverage limits and environment constraints belong here when they exist.

artifactPath.description: Exactly the artifact name the phase declares in team.yml; the runtime writes the reply body there and rejects any other value.

summary.description: Structured Chinese summary of test-report.md: which acceptance criteria were covered, the pass/fail/not-executed counts with their evidence, and the main defects by severity.

openQuestions.description: Acceptance criteria no test covered (with the reason), environment limits, and defects that could not be reproduced; empty only when the plan executed fully and left nothing unverified.
